# Logging Review

Review logging quality and consistency.

## Verify

- SLF4J usage
- placeholders {}
- correct log levels
- useful business context

## Never Log

- tokens
- passwords
- secrets
- PII
- document contents

## Required Context

- correlationId
- documentId
- messageId
- batchId
